description: Admin Dashboard UI built with Shadcn and Vite.
summary: It's a set of dashboard pages—sidebar, command palette, data tables, light/dark toggle—built on Shadcn so you copy the components into your own app instead of inheriting a whole template, which is exactly the shape I want when I need to wire up an admin panel for Proreerfolio without spending a week on layout boilerplate. The author is explicit that it's a component collection, not a starter, and the Shadcn CLI stays usable for the non-customized pieces, so it slots into an existing Vite + Tailwind project with almost no friction. The RTL and accessibility pass on the Radix primitives is a nice touch I'd rather not have to do myself.
